$comment: Curated external FSL learning resources shown on /learn.
Adding one is a data edit: append an object here, no code change. Every
entry needs title, url, topic, creator and verifiedOn.
ATTRIBUTION. `creator` is the actual channel or publisher, taken from the
YouTube oEmbed API rather than typed from memory, because this is a thesis
artefact and these are other people's work. Cite them from this field.
LINK ROT. Every url below returned HTTP 200 on the verifiedOn date. External
links decay — re-check before the defense. `npm run verify:tutorials` walks
Two candidates were dropped rather than shipped unverified: an INQUIRER.net
article (403 to non-browser clients) and a Facebook page (400). Both may work
in a browser, but a link that cannot be checked automatically will rot
